text: BAM share rose 0.29 percentage points over 26 hours to 35.7%, extending a 1.2 percentage point gain over 7 days. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 24.3% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. Leadership changes remain whale-driven routing rather than a structural rollover; only the fra rollover on 2026-06-24 has been validated.
